rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE JUVENILE JUSTICE SYSTEM, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Comprehensive Juvenile Justice System" Applies to all youth offenders who are over nine (9) years but under eighteen (18) years of age at the time of the commission of the offense. Provides for a humane, effective and fair treatment of juvenile offenders in all stages of legal proceedings. Emphasizes on the promotion of the well-being and the rehabilitation of the offenders rather than on exacting retribution to them.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 31 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED 1177, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE BUDGET REFORM DECREE OF 1977 IN ORDER TO LIMIT AUTOMATIC APPROPRIATION OF DEBTS AND GUARANTEES ONLY TO THOSE DULY APPROVED BY CONGRESS
rows.abstract: Restores control of the public funds by providing that only loans and guarantees approved by Congress be the subject of automatic appropriations. rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MATERNITY LEAVE BENEFITS AS INCENTIVES FOR BREASTFEEDING MOTHERS IN THE PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SECTOR
rows.abstract: Increasing maternity leave benefits from sixty (60) days to ONE HUNDRED EIGHTY (180) DAYS WHICH may COMMENCE THIRTY DAYS BEFORE THE EXPECTED DATE OF DELIVERY and that the remaining ninety days leave should serve the purpose of breastfeeding the new-born baby. Entitles the employee to a full pay of her basic monthly salary, allowances and other benefits for ninety days of maternity leave.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1995-08-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR BICYCLE LANES IN ALL MAIN ROADS AND HIGHWAYS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Provides for bicycle lanes in all main roads and highways all over the country to lessen traffic and air pollution problems. Requires the District Engineer to place marks on existing main roads and highways to indicate bicycle lanes. Requires, further, that no new main road or highway shall be constructed without the required bicycle lanes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1995-08-15

rows.abstract: Requires all students from elementary, secondary and tertiary levels, whether public or private schools, to plant at least ten (10) trees as a requisite for graduation. Provides that the planting of trees should be done in their respective school grounds, in public places sych as plazas, markets, roadside and parks or in public lands. Provides, further, that the trees to be planted shall be fruit bearing, shafe, ornamental or forest trees.
